text:
Jen (Support): JP opened a ticket — SSE stream with CF in front of ALB drops after ~45s of silence, client reconnects and sometimes processes duplicated events. Billing spike reported.

JP (Customer): Repro steps:
1) curl -v -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.customer.example/v1/stream?prompt=hi"
2) wait 40-60s without events
3) client sees last partial chunk then TCP CLOSE, reconnects and we get duplicate logical events.
Headers we see: Via: 1.1 cloudflare, x-amzn-trace-id / ALB request id present, ALB -> target group shows 200 then FIN. Using HTTP/2 CF->ALB.

Jen (Support): Can you paste one example request-id + time when it happened? Also are you using any origin proxies (nginx) behind ALB?

JP (Customer): example request-id: a1b2c3d4. No nginx on origin, direct app instances.

Rohit (Eng): A few quick items to check:
- Server: are you emitting SSE comment heartbeats like ":\\n\\n" or a ping event regularly? If you don't flush, proxies may buffer.
- Ensure Transfer-Encoding: chunked, Connection: keep-alive. Some frameworks buffer until a chunk boundary.
- ALB default idle timeout = 60s; if Cloudflare's frontend sends different keepalives you can get half-close.

Rohit (Eng): Local minimal repro we use (node):
```
res.writeHead(200, {
  'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream',
  'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
  'Connection': 'keep-alive',
  'Transfer-Encoding': 'chunked'
});
setInterval(() => {
  res.write(':hb\\n\\n'); // SSE comment heartbeat
  // if using express / koa, call res.flush() where available
}, 20000);
```
If heartbeats arrive < ALB idle timeout, the ALB won't close. Also some runtimes buffer until you call flush.

Olivia (SRE): Proxy notes:
- Cloudflare: HTTP/2 multiplexing to origin can cause partial chunk coalescing. Try disabling HTTP/2 on the zone or test with HTTP/1.1 to see if behavior clears up.
- ALB: half-close behavior when idle timeout reached. Bump idle timeout (e.g., 120s) for testing.
- Envoy/nginx: proxy_buffering/default buffering can merge chunks. For nginx origin, add: `proxy_buffering off; proxy_http_version 1.1; chunked_transfer_encoding on; tcp_nodelay on;`

Olivia (SRE): Important for dedupe and billing: add an `id:` line to each SSE event (id: <uuid-or-seq>) so clients and our billing can dedupe on reconnect. Server should maintain event ids stable across reconnect windows.

JP (Customer): If we can't change ALB timeout (managed by infra), is there a client-side mitigation?

Rohit (Eng): Client-side: implement id-based dedupe and ignore events with ids already processed. Also backoff reconnects and request a short-range resume if you track last event id (SSE supports Last-Event-ID header).

Jen (Support): Actionable steps for JP to try now:
- Temporarily disable HTTP/2 on Cloudflare for the zone and retest.
- Increase ALB idle timeout to 120s if possible.
- Make server emit `:hb\\n\\n` every 15-25s and call flush where applicable.
- Add `id:` to SSE messages so client can dedupe after reconnect.
- If using any origin proxies, set `proxy_buffering off` as Olivia suggested.

JP (Customer): We'll try disabling HTTP/2 and adding heartbeat + id on events. Also will add client dedupe logic. We'll share request-id if it reproduces.

Rohit (Eng): One more thing: Cloudflare has internal buffering heuristics for text/event-stream; even with heartbeats, sometimes the last tiny chunk is held until connection close. If disabling HTTP/2 not an option, increase heartbeat frequency to force flush and include small payloads (not just comments).

Olivia (SRE): For billing spike: server-side can also record event-id when billing is emitted and ignore duplicate billing within a short window (30-120s) for the same id from the same connection. Combine with client dedupe to be safe.

Jen (Support): I'll file an eng-runtime follow-up with trace id a1b2c3d4 + JP's repro notes if they reproduce.

JP (Customer): Reproduced locally after disabling HTTP/2: still saw one case where the client got a partial final chunk then connection close. We then increased heartbeat to every 10s and problem stopped. Will monitor billing.

Deploy Bot: deploy-9876 runtime/sse-heartbeat-tests ✔ in staging (added heartbeat + flush unit tests).
